ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Digicontent Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
ESOP/ESOS/ESPS — Digicontent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Equity Shares under  Digicontent Limited - Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2025  ( RSU Plan - 2025 ).
General Updates — Digicontent Limited has informed the Exchange about Buyback of equity shares by HT Digital Streams Limited (Material Unlisted Wholly-Owned Subsidiary)
Allotment of Securities — Digicontent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 14085571 warrants pursuant to Preferential Issue on September 03, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Digicontent Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations —  The Hindustan Times Ltd has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Digicontent Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Digicontent Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Resignation — Digicontent Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Ms. Manu Chaudhary as Company Secretary & Compliance Officer of the company w.e.f. May 31, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Digicontent Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
